answer: A newcomer posts collateral, like a pearl sealed in its shell, before it may speak. Reviewers pull random past work down the vine of history and re-grade it; each confirmed cheat strips the deposit, and proven fraud forfeits every coin it holds. A haven for fakes never forms, because each forged identity needs its own funded stake and a record that survives every surprise audit — a price no Sybil farm can profit from.
